record.field: The Branch Manager is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of the restaurant branch, supervising staff, ensuring high standards of customer service, managing schedules and inventory, maintaining compliance with company policies and health regulations, and achieving operational and financial targets.

• 9 hours (including one-hour break), 6 days per week.
• One day off weekly (day off determined by business needs).
Salary details are shown in the salary breakdown table below.
As per Bahraini Labour Law unless otherwise agreed in writing.

The Employee shall:

• Maintain high professional conduct.
• Protect all business information.
• Not share or copy any brand materials (recipes, menus, designs, etc.).
• Not engage with competitors during employment.
• Not defame or harm the Company's interests in any form.

All work products and information remain the exclusive property of Dona's Wonders W.L.L.
All intellectual property, business information, and work products created or obtained during employment belong exclusively to the Company and are confidential.

• All devices, files, assets, passwords, and company data must be returned immediately upon termination.
• Company systems and software are for authorized business use only.
• Failure to return company property or unauthorized deletion may result in disciplinary/legal action.
Annual leave, sick leave, and statutory entitlements are provided in accordance with Bahraini Labour Law unless otherwise agreed in writing.
This Agreement is governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Bahrain.
This Agreement represents the entire understanding between the Employer and Employee, superseding any prior agreements. Amendments must be in writing and signed by both parties.
